ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organ removes carbon dioxide from the blood and provides it with oxygen?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is “Respiratory System”. The chest area is labeled “Right lung” and “Left lung”, and near the lungs it is labeled “Pulmonary vessels”. The image also shows respiratory system structures such as the trachea and bronchi. Reasoning: The question asks which organ removes carbon dioxide from the blood and provides oxygen to the blood. According to biological knowledge, gas exchange between blood and air occurs in the lungs: oxygen enters the blood, and carbon dioxide leaves the blood. Therefore this organ is the lungs.
